name: promptcraft
description: Turn development discussions into execution-ready Claude Code or Codex prompts. Developed by the dondego.com team.

interface.longDescription:
PromptingCraft.com helps AI assistants turn a development discussion into a clear, execution-ready prompt for a coding agent such as Codex or Claude Code.

It identifies the task requirements, preserves decisions already made, checks applicable official guidance from AI model developers, writes a draft, critiques it, and returns one final copyable prompt.

It can also review an existing prompt: it points out unnecessary instructions and changes in scope, and when a prompt is already suitable it recommends leaving it unchanged.

Model-specific recommendations come from official OpenAI and Anthropic documentation. A public source registry records where each recommendation comes from, and the project's own methodology is labeled separately from official guidance.

Checking current guidance depends on the tools and access available in the conversation. When live retrieval is unavailable, PromptingCraft.com says whether it used dated cached guidance or none.

PromptingCraft.com writes and reviews prompts only. It does not run the development task, edit code or grant permissions, and it does not guarantee better downstream results. No account, credentials, MCP server or setup is required.

PromptingCraft.com is developed independently and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Anthropic.

Developed by the dondego.com team.
defaultPrompt: Turn the discussion above into one execution-ready Codex prompt.
Review this Claude Code prompt and improve it without changing its scope.
Apply current official guidance to this agent prompt and keep my intent.
